occurrences.text: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;
And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;
The Lord said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,
That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.
He maketh the barren woman to keep house, and to be a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the Lord.
Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.
For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.
Unto thee lift I up mine eyes, O thou that dwellest in the heavens.
They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.
If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

occurrences.text: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.

And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she being desolate shall sit upon the ground.

Madmenah is removed; the inhabitants of Gebim gather themselves to flee.
Cry out and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion: for great is the Holy One of Israel in the midst of thee.

All ye inhabitants of the world, and dwellers on the earth, see ye, when he lifteth up an ensign on the mountains; and when he bloweth a trumpet, hear ye.

And I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand: and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

occurrences.text: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.

Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon, sit on the ground: there is no throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

Which remain among the graves, and lodge in the monuments, which eat swine’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;
And they shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of them.

Egypt, and Judah, and Edom, and the children of Ammon, and Moab, and all that are in the utmost corners, that dwell in the wilderness: for all these nations are uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel are uncircumcised in the heart.
Gather up thy wares out of the land, O inhabitant of the fortress.
